title: sonogram~
description: `sonogram~` records an FFT-based sonogram from a loaded sound, allows its frequency-domain data to be modified, and plays the resynthesized result. It supports operations such as filtering or enhancing frequencies, swapping or reversing regions, phase changes, smoothing, thresholding, zoom, reading-speed control, and one-level undo; the help patch notes that it must run with a redefined block size.
